If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is 0.00 and forecast is above 80.00, reduce forecast by 2–3% for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment is 0.67 and forecast is below 78.00, increase forecast by 1–2% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is 0.33 and forecast is above 80.00, reduce forecast by 1–2% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is 0.00 and forecast is below 78.00, increase forecast by 1–2% for late horizon (16–30 days).
